title: Normative Common Ground Replication (NormCoRe): Replication-by-Translation for Studying Norms in Multi-agent AI
reasoning: The paper focuses on evaluating and replicating social and ethical norms, specifically distributive justice and fairness principles, within multi-agent LLM systems. It uses philosophical frameworks like Rawls' 'veil of ignorance' to benchmark moral and normative judgments.
